BiblicalUsage: To gird on — Moses girding Aaron with the ephod when he dressed him for the priesthood, and the same dressing repeated at the consecration. The word is the fastening of the garment that marks the priest for service.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the girding matters because God dresses his priests himself: the service starts with what he puts on, not with what we bring.
